text:
nina: Heads-up — after a proxy pool failover (proxy-52 -> proxy-73) at 11:02 UTC we saw a short but sharp reconnect surge from EU clients. Heartbeats look like they re-attached to stale resume ids; quota/billing spiked.

sam: Link/trace?

nina: https://console.redwood/trace/abc123 
proxy logs snippet:```text
[2026-03-22T11:02:12Z] proxy=proxy-52 lease_epoch=1 accepted resume_token=abc...
[2026-03-22T11:02:12Z] proxy=proxy-73 lease_epoch=0 accepted resume_token=abc...
```

devon: That explains it — new proxy didn't see the tombstone for that resume token, so it accepted the resume as a fresh session. We're double-counting token usage and the console shows one session but backend has two active leases.

priya: :thinking_face: Is this the sticky-routing TTL problem or something different?

sam: Different. Sticky TTL keeps you on the same proxy; this is a failover where state wasn't replicated.

devon: Short-term mitigation options: 1) on failover, sync tombstones to the new proxy (expensive), 2) have new proxy reject resume tokens that have epoch < last_seen_epoch for that tenant for N seconds (cheap), 3) have new proxy return a clear 409/410 with Retry-After to force client backoff.

nina: I prefer (2) + (3) as quick fix. New proxy should return an explicit rejection so SDKs back off with jitter instead of hammering and being billed twice.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `tombstone-sync-fallback` in eu-east (10% proxies).

priya: Console UX: current session timeline shows proxy-73 only; ops billing shows duplicate token counts. We need `proxy_id` and `lease_epoch` surfaced per-session in the console and in the request logs so SRE can correlate.

sam: Telemetry ask: add metric `stream.resume_reject_reason` (tagged by proxy_id, lease_epoch, tenant_id) and a dashboard tile for resume_reject_rate and resume_accept_epoch_mismatch. That will make the Canary safety checks easier.

devon: Implementation note for server: easiest is keep a short LRU of recent resume_token hashes with last_seen_epoch for 30s after failover and reject if incoming epoch < last_seen. If we have time later, do tombstone replication via raft events.

nina: Who owns console/ticketing? priya take console; sam update SDK backoff behavior; devon implement server reject; I'll coordinate rollout with ops.

priya: I can add `proxy_id` and `lease_epoch` to session timeline and add alert: `resume_reject_rate > 0.3%` for 5m. ETA for console change: 4 hours for rollout to staging, then canary.

sam: SDK patch: when server returns 409/410 include `Retry-After`; SDK will honor it and use exp backoff. I'll open PR and bump client minor.

ops-bot: incident-note: INF-4823 created and assigned to devon, priya, sam, nina.

nina: Plan: implement quick reject + SDK backoff + console telemetry. Revisit tombstone replication later. Check back in ~1h after canary metrics. Thanks all :thumbsup:
